answer_1.quote: Generating coherent long text (e.g., 1000s of tokens) is useful in myriad applications of creating reports, essays, and other long-form content.
answer_1.outputs: Long text passages such as news articles and stories

answer_2.quote: We evaluate with a broad array of automatic metrics, including lexical-based quality metrics and semantic-based quality metrics. We also evaluate the generation diversity. MS-Jaccard (MSJ) is a lexical-based metric...

answer_4.quote: In our human study, we asked three university students who are proficient English speakers to evaluate the coherence and fluency of the generated text.
answer_4.guideline: Human raters assign a coherence score to each full-length text sample on a 5-point Likert scale for passage-level coherence, label each sentence for coherence with context (0 or 1), and evaluate a fluency score on a 5-point Likert scale.
